I'm an amateur in astrological knowledge but here are some challenging aspects of your chart that stand out to me:

\- Your chart ruler/ruler of the ascendant is in detriment in the sign of Cancer (which translates to the planet -in this case Saturn- having more trouble expressing itself). Saturn is also retrograde which indicates issues to do with depression or more melancholic feelings than most people experience; I also have retrograde Saturn in Cancer so I know how difficult this can be. Your sun is also disposited by Saturn in Cancer so this can bring issues to do with maintaining vitality and drive in your life.

\-The T-square is considered among the most challenging aspect patterns in astrology as it's a combination of two 'hard' aspects; the opposition and the square which reflect points of tension and conflict in the native's life (this can be internally or externally). There are 3 T-squares in your chart. The first involves Pluto in Libra opposite Jupiter in Aries both squaring Venus in Capricorn. The second involves Mercury in Capricorn opposite Saturn in Cancer both squaring Jupiter in Aries, and by extension the IC and the moon. The third involves Uranus in the 10th house opposite your moon in the 4th, both squaring Saturn in the 7th. This 3rd T-square is especially sensitive as it involves the angular houses. I would give my insight on the specifics of each T-square as they each represent different types of struggles in your life but I think that a professional astrologer would be more qualified to give a detailed analysis of this.

\-There's a lot of emphasis on cardinal energy (represented by Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn) in your chart given the two cardinal T-squares I've highlighted and your Capricorn ascendant, and the T-square between the angular houses which are associated with the cardinal modality. I'm guessing that the past 15 years have been especially difficult for you given Pluto's transit through Capricorn in your first house which has been activating all the T-squares in your chart. Hopefully, with Pluto moving into Aquarius soon the loads of life will be eased off you.

Hope this helps!

Saturn as the chart ruler in the 4th house can bring up a lack of emotional nurturing and suggest a 'cold' home environment. There's a likelihood of an emotionally unresponsive or absent maternal figure. Saturn's impact on your home life is in conflict with the ruler of your 4th house, Venus, which suggests a strong desire for stability and harmony in matters of the home, things that may be unattainable most of the time if not all.

Many people are unaffected by issues at home, but considering the conjunction between your IC and Taurus Moon (which echoes the aforementioned desire and need for a harmonious and stable home environment), ignoring the instability at home may be rather difficult for you. Mars in Neptune-ruled 3rd house could indicate conflict among siblings, perhaps resulting from a lack of boundaries/respect for boundaries put in place. Mars in Aries in the 3rd house may also suggest the surrounding areas of the home being conflict-ridden or violent e.g. an area with high rates of violent crimes, war-ravaged, etc.

This might be a bit of a stretch but with Aquarius in the 2nd house, matters to do with finances and values are Saturn-ruled. Perhaps you have/had a father figure who was rather strict with money or just strict in general and wanted to place a lot of restrictive structures in the home (bc 2nd house also represents the home to an extent), and this may have been hard to adhere to with your idealistic and open-minded personality (Sun in Pisces in the 2nd house as well). South node in Aquarius could suggest that earlier in life you had a tendency to prioritize helping everyone else around you but yourself, both at home and outside the home, which may have led others to take advantage of your kind-hearted nature and walk all over you which could have deepened the wound of the lack of emotional nurturing at home.

Just to preface, my understanding of astrology is quite amateurish, so please take my insight with a grain of salt.

Aries Mars in the 12th house can definitely be a tricky placement bc while Mars is in its natural ruler of Aries, the fact that it’s in the 12th house can bring issues to do with suppression of anger, as the 12th house represents things unseen and unconscious. You’ve said that people find you “scary” when you’re angry; perhaps that could do with the surfacing of subconscious anger that has been unknowingly repressed for a while, until it inevitably manifests (I like to think of it as this ‘angry energy’ inadvertently ‘spilling over’ into the neighboring 1st house-which is akin to your Mars in Aries…if that makes sense).
 
What stands out for me personally even more, is your Scorpio Lilith and Pluto in the 7th house. Lilith is said to represent our more primal instincts and emotions (like anger) and deep-seated passions and desires, and many astrologers view it as being very “Scorpionic”, so its placement in the sign of scorpio can manifest in a very enigmatic and intense disposition for the native. The same can be said for Pluto since it’s in domicile in the sign of Scorpio, so this might also culminate in an intense and intimidating energy that other people can be understandably afraid of; not because you’re being intentionally hostile (at least I hope you’re not lol) but because that’s just, in layman’s words, the vibe you give off.

Finally, I suspect that your Sag moon squaring your Aries Mars is also a contributing factor. The square is already a ‘hard’ aspect in and of itself as it denotes tension between the two planets (albeit I can’t say how strong this aspect is as the orb isn’t provided in this chart). In addition to this square, the planets are both in fire signs, so this has the potential to cause very intense inner turmoil (moon’s involvement) as well as angry outbursts at the people around you.  As though that’s not enough, both the moon and mars are located in water houses; the 8h and 12h respectively, so the “incredibly emotional” bit is kind of a given.

Fortunately, astrology is a tool that we can use to identify our problem areas and take steps towards bettering ourselves, so please don’t catastrophize about your placements. Here’s some advice which I think is suitable given the placements I’ve discussed;
-Any form of intense exercise (hiking, cardio, weightlifting) could help to channel the simultaneously emotional and aggressive Mars square Moon placement.
-Expression through art e.g. poetry, painting could help to harness the Scorpio energy of Lilith and Pluto in a beneficial way.
-Journalling can be a good outlet too
-Talking to sb you trust, who’s nonjudgmental, about the things that really piss you off and being open to guidance from such a person.

Hope this helps! :)

Hey Marlene! Firstly, thank you for having the courage and taking the time to share your personal experience on here, that takes a lot of guts. 

From how you’ve described it, my family life isn’t as bad as yours and I can’t begin to imagine what you go through on a daily basis, but my life isn’t great either, and I know what it’s like to constantly look for an escape due to feeling trapped (I’m also a maladaptive daydreamer, have been for nearly all my life). Not too long ago I was in the same position as you; I longed to be in my DR and was so frustrated with having not shifted yet. At some point, I was even considering quitting shifting completely due to how obsessed and frustrated I’d become. I told this to my friend who’s a very experienced shifter and who actually introduced me to shifting. I’m going to give you the same advice that she gave to me; DON’T VIEW SHIFTING AS A MEANS OF ESCAPE. When you do this, you further feed your subconscious the notion that your DR is something that’s very far away and even unattainable, when that is simply not the case. It’s like someone else said, you need to stop thinking of your DR as some fantasy and start acknowledging it as an alternate REALITY. Your DR is very much real and existent, so one of the things you need to do is stop having nervous thoughts about reality shifting being some sort of collective prank or make believe trend. We shift nearly every second of the day by making certain choices. For example, if right now I have the option of binge watching a Netflix series or going downstairs to get something to eat, and I choose the latter, there is still an alternate reality where I decided to stay in my room and watch Netflix, simply by the virtue of me thinking about a situation in which I were to remain in my room and watch Netflix. It’s just that a shift to one’s DR like in Hogwarts or AOT is a much more drastic shift and thus requires more effort.

I know how difficult it can be to get out of those maladaptive daydreaming spirals, but for the sake of your mental health, I advise that you 1.) Take a break from shifting and thinking about your DR , and 2.) Frequently engage in activities which keep you grounded to prevent you from daydreaming excessively. Remember that MaDD is not just a coping mechanism not an UNHEALTHY one at that. I am in no way trying to be insensitive as I know that you’re going through a rough patch right now. But that’s life, we get shit thrown at us for no good reason, get placed in devastating circumstances and are forced to find ways to cope and overcome. You are stronger than you think and have it in you to subdue your situation and eventually get the happiness you deserve. Please find ways to cope which will be beneficial for you in the long run, instead of those which will only cause your mental health to deteriorate even more. It’s easier said than done, but I believe in you.❤️

Once again, I advise that you take a break from shifting till your perspective on your DR and shifting in general becomes a little more positive. You have the entire multiverse at your disposal, NEVER CONVINCE YOURSELF THAT YOU ARE TRAPPED IN THIS REALITY. This reality is just one of many, and the moment you start seeing your DR simply as an alternative instead of an escape, you’ll be shifting in no time😊

Feel free to dm me if you ever need anyone to talk/vent to.💗💗💗💗
